meta.title: Ocean West Studio | Luxury Wedding Photography
meta.description: Luxury wedding photography & cinematography — capturing authentic stories worldwide.

spinningBadge: WEDDINGS • FILMS • PHOTOGRAPHY • OCEAN WEST STUDIO •

hero.tagline: If you are looking for an authentic wedding photographer, capable of capturing the essence of your story and your emotions, you are in the right place. As a high-end wedding photographer, I go far beyond traditional photos, creating unique and unforgettable memories.

philosophy.text: Don't be afraid! I understand your concerns and want to make it easier for you. My team and I will help you to feel comfortable, natural and have fun. Reflecting who you really are in the most authentic way possible, capture all excitement, tears, joy and create photos and videos which would last forever.

team.label: The Founders
team.intro: With over a decade of documenting love stories across the globe, our foundation is built on blending editorial precision with raw, documentary intuition. We don't just take photographs; we craft heirlooms.

members.name: Heena Malhotra
members.bio: Elena brings an editorial eye and an unobtrusive approach, ensuring every frame is intentionally composed to immortalize the fleeting atmosphere and unseen glances of your day.

members.name: Eddie Licea
members.bio: Julian's cinematic approach translates raw emotion into moving heirlooms. He focuses on narrative storytelling, preserving the grand architecture and dynamic energy of your celebration.

services.label: Service
services.intro: Our solutions are tailored to meet the unique vision of your celebration, providing artistry, reliability, and elegance at every stage of your journey.

items.title: Editorial & Timeless Stills
items.desc: Curated, timeless imagery that captures both the grand moments and the quiet, unseen details. We focus on natural light, sophisticated composition, and raw emotion to build a visual legacy that feels authentically you.

items.title: Cinematic & Emotional Films
items.desc: Moving portraiture that tells the narrative of your day. We create elegant, emotion-driven films scored to perfectly tailored music, preserving the atmosphere, the spoken vows, and the dynamic energy of your celebration.

items.title: Wedding Live Broadcasting
items.desc: Share your most cherished moments in real-time with loved ones across the globe. We provide high-fidelity audio and multi-camera streaming to ensure no one misses your celebration.

portfolio.intro: These photographs are chosen again and again, finding in them a familiar feeling of beauty and the exact mood. Look, get inspired and feel — perhaps they will respond to you today and become part of your legacy.

caption1.title: Quiet beauty
caption1.body: Moments in which natural elegance unfolds quietly, confidently, and without unnecessary emphasis.

caption2.title: Natural harmony
caption2.body: Connections whose shape, energy, and rhythm create a profound sense of harmony at first glance.

testimonial.quote: Working with Ocean West was the best investment we made. Their presence was calming, and the resulting work belongs in a magazine. They captured our love exactly as it felt.
testimonial.name: Eleanor & James

items.q: How long do we have to wait for our photos and video?
items.a: For a full day celebration, you can expect your complete, meticulously curated gallery and cinematic film delivered within 8 to 10 weeks.

items.q: Do you give out raw images?
items.a: We do not provide raw files. Our dedicated color grading and editorial editing process is a fundamental part of the final artistic vision you invest in.
